item.title: Reviewing Agent-Generated Code at Scale: Six Verification Layers on the Claude Code Team
item.description: How the Claude Code team—where Claude writes roughly 90% of the code—replaced line-by-line human gatekeeping with six automated verification layers, risk-based approval counts, convergence rules for agent review loops, and fast rollback.
